'''Hardin''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] operating out of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He continually modified his [[L2 Base Labor Droid]], surprised that it still operated.
